name: The Car and the Century It Made
description: From a steam wagon to the electric car: how cheap engines, rubber and oil put the world on wheels and changed where and how we live.

checkpoints.name: Before the car
checkpoints.note: Bicycles, rickshaws and stagecoaches move people while inventors tinker with steam wagons and gas engines. Rubber and oil, two future necessities, are found and made useful.

checkpoints.name: Motoring for all
checkpoints.note: Benz patents a petrol car, Diesel builds his engine and Henry Ford brings the price of a Model T down until ordinary families can buy one.

checkpoints.name: Small cars and scooters
checkpoints.note: After the war, cheap and clever small vehicles put Europe and Asia on the road: the Beetle, the 2CV, the Vespa, the Honda Super Cub and the Mini.

checkpoints.name: The electric turn
checkpoints.note: Better batteries, hybrids and electric sports cars begin to challenge the petrol engine, while very cheap cars try to reach new buyers.
